text: The authors define a recursive decomposition as A-provable with probability 1-gamma if a single strategy A in the set of functions A_n, with probability at least 1-gamma over inputs, answers every query in the decomposition correctly, satisfies A(x, j) = u_j for every j in S_i in the base case of the decomposition (where S_i is the subset given by y_i0), and answers the original question correctly. They describe this as capturing problems where an AI can solve any subproblem if asked and so in some sense 'knows' the answer.
title: A-provability: one strategy answers every subproblem in the decomposition
